title: Cluster Tideboard: Mini-dashboard & Autoscale Knobs for Dedicated GPU Pools
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design and prototype a compact cluster-level dashboard (Tideboard) focused on per-pool health snapshot, autoscaling control knobs, and burst tuning presets. The goal is a lightweight surface that SREs and infra owners can scan in <10s to assess capacity risk, apply quick autoscale changes, and trigger short-lived burst policies without switching to the full Fleet Ops canvas. This ticket covers concept sketches, Figma prototype, design review notes, and handoff artifacts for engineering. Key constraints: prioritize information density with clear affordances for destructive actions, keep interaction patterns consistent with Console design system, and support progressive disclosure so novice users are not overwhelmed.
acceptance_criteria: Compact Tideboard mockups in Figma: default collapsed state and expanded pool detail
Three autoscale knob patterns (percentile, target-concurrency, burst-duration) with microcopy and guardrails
Prototype demonstrates applying a burst preset and an autoscale policy change (with confirmation flow)
Design tokens and component references documented for engineers (button states, color for SLO bands, tooltip copy)
Accessibility checklist completed: keyboard interactions, color contrast, screen reader labels for key controls
comments: 2025-02-10 — Asha Patel: Kickoff: synced with PM (Rafael) and SRE (Nora) on pain points: slow context switching between Fleet Ops and per-pool needs; agreed to a mini-dashboard for on-call flows.

2025-02-11 — Liam Chen: Initial sketches attached. Three candidate layouts: (A) compact card with sparkline + SLO band; (B) mini-map with pool heatmap; (C) stacked tiles showing autoscale knobs. Leaning toward A+B hybrid.
2025-02-12 — Rafael Gomez (PM): Feedback: Keep primary CTA to 'Adjust autoscale' rather than exposing raw sliders. Add confirmation modal copy and link to billing implications for burst policies.
2025-02-13 — Design Review: @Design Team: raised concern about too many controls in collapsed state; recommended progressive reveal and a 'quick apply' burst preset list.

2025-02-14 — Engineering sync (ENG-72911 owner): Confirmed runtime constraints: burst requests require validating GPU availability across zones and may take 20-60s to provision. Suggested showing a provisioning state in the prototype.
2025-02-15 — Accessibility check: Updated contrast for SLO band overlays and added aria-labels for each autoscale knob. Screen reader notes added to Figma.

2025-02-16 — PM sign-off (Rafael Gomez): Approved concept with one change — expose estimated cost delta when applying a burst preset (approximate tokens/day cost line). Assigned ENG-73102 for infra validation.

2025-02-17 — Liam Chen: Uploaded final Figma frames and a click-through prototype. Ready for engineering handoff. Noted two follow-ups: validation endpoint for cost estimate and server-side guardrails for burst duration.
2025-02-17 — Design Ops: Prepared component spec doc and exportable token list for frontend: button variants, microcopy strings, modal templates.
